name: pret-gba-tools
notes: Tools built from the tools/ folder of pret/pokeemerald commit 731ad5b (extracted via git archive into a fresh scratch dir, clang, flags from pret build logs). Binaries in bin/: bin2c, gbafix, gbagfx, jsonproc, mapjson, mid2agb, preproc, ramscrgen, rsfont, scaninc, wav2agb. test.sh exercises gbagfx (PNG and LZ77 round trip), preproc (charmap .string), scaninc (transitive includes) and gbafix (ROM header patch). Passed on 2026-10-16. Licence file is in the pinned tools/ folder (not read).
